items.title: 68146_Russell Procope oral history interview
items.q: I like Willy 'the Lion's' style... Willis 'the Lion' plays 'Carolina Shout,' man, that's the classic all time great

ctx.x: No. You know they put these names on people. You can't say who is who or what is what, way back to Scott Joplin. What the hell, I mean, you know, all these guys, they played, one copied from the other and the other copied from -- even now you have Fats Waller on a record and you're not sure it's Fats, you know. You say, "Yeah, that's Fats," and then you had Jimmy Johnson, you know. You know, playing about along the same lines. But out of all those piano players, you know, I like Willy "the Lion's" style. You…
sort of (Imitating piano). You know, that style. He plays a lot of things. Plus, he can -- look here, Willis "the Lion" plays "Carolina Shout," man, that's the classic all time great, you know. Yeah.
Now, you -- now, what is this about Lieutenant Eugene Mikell and the 369th [Street] Cadets?
